analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 25,470) vs SMA5 (KRW 25,029) / SMA20 (KRW 27,420) / SMA50 (KRW 31,773): Confirmed entry into a sideways range, trading above short-term SMA5 but below medium-term SMA20.
· Significant underperformance relative to SMA100 (KRW 33,961) / SMA200 (KRW 36,495) maintains strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (21.6%) + Current price is elevated from the 52-week low but historically low relative to the high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 35.7 → 42.2 (staying neutral): Exited oversold territory and is now seeking direction.
· MACD histogram -124.0384 → 4.7845 (improving): Moving out of bearish territory and attempting to build a base, but trend reversal signals remain weak.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Middle Band KRW 27,420): Bandwidth at 39.99% indicates entry into a period of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 25,055): Technical support zone near SMA5 and Pivot S1 (KRW 20,992).
· Swing Resistance (KRW 29,050): A breakout above this level suggests potential for a short-term trend reversal.
· 5-day / 20-day Highs & Lows Pattern: 5-day high KRW 26,310, 20-day high KRW 33,675 / 5-day low KRW 22,855, 20-day low KRW 22,855: No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.94): Normal level compared to the 5-day average, suggesting moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI holding neutral and MACD showing weak improvement, indicating an accumulation phase due to lack of directional momentum. A wait-and-see approach is advised to confirm indicator direction.
